narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A diamond is not a square, so its dots cannot make a square number.
<bookmark mark='back'/>Turn the diamond back, and you see the same dots sitting in a square.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Turning a picture changes how it looks, but it never changes how many dots there are.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Rows that count up and then down are a square grid of dots seen from its corner.
